builder.note: You're here because you have a sales or operations problem that's costing you real money — leads falling through, manual work that shouldn't exist, or a pipeline no one can actually see. This is a real project I built for a real client. Watch the demo below and see exactly what changes when the system is built right.

hero.title:
They were running their
business on
spreadsheets & guesswork.
We fixed that.
hero.body: Zerodown had a real pipeline — they just couldn't see it. Leads were slipping, follow-ups were manual, and the team had no single source of truth. We replaced all of it with one automated system. Built in 2 weeks. Here's how it runs.

problem.heading: What was breaking
problem.sub: If any of these look familiar, you're looking at your own situation.
pains: Leads tracked in spreadsheets — no automation, no reminders, no shared history
Follow-ups depended entirely on someone remembering to do them
No visibility into where any deal stood without asking the team directly
Tools that didn't connect — data scattered across email, Sheets, and memory

built.heading: Four systems. One working product.
built.sub: Each one eliminating a specific gap in how they operated.

items.title: Automated CRM pipeline
items.desc: Leads flow in, get categorised, and move through stages — without anyone touching a spreadsheet.

items.title: Smart follow-up engine
items.desc: Sequences triggered by deal stage. The right message goes out at the right time, automatically.

items.title: Live ops dashboard
items.desc: One screen. Every deal. Where it is, what's stalled, what needs action — no asking around.

items.title: Fully connected stack
items.desc: Email, calendar, comms — all integrated. Data lives in one place. Nothing falls through the cracks.

outcome.heading: What changed in month one
outcome.sub: Measured after the system went live.

testimonial.heading: What Zerodown said
testimonial.sub: After seeing the system live for the first time.
testimonial.quote: Before this, I had no idea where our leads actually stood unless I chased the team. Mudassir built something that runs exactly the way our business runs — not some generic tool we had to adapt ourselves. The first time I saw the dashboard, every deal was right there. That was the moment I knew we'd made the right call.
testimonial.author: Zerodown Founder

process.heading: What the process looks like
process.sub: No retainers. No padded timelines. No surprises.

steps.title: One call — I diagnose the real problem
steps.desc: Most clients say they need X. The actual fix is usually Y. I'll tell you which after one conversation.

steps.title: I scope it tight, build it fast
steps.desc: Clear spec. Milestone payments. Working system in weeks — not a 3-month project that keeps moving.

steps.title: You own everything from day one
steps.desc: Code, data, logins, integrations — all yours. No lock-in. No dependency on me to keep it running.

steps.title: You go live. I stay available for 30 days.
